items.title: Why Global Hotel Alliance Is Turning to Saudi Arabia Despite Riyadh’s Slump
items.why: A major hotel loyalty alliance is redirecting growth to Saudi Arabia, so watch for new Gulf loyalty tie-ups.
items.summary_ai: Global Hotel Alliance is limiting growth in the UAE and shifting its focus to Saudi Arabia despite a hotel slump there.
items.take: A major hotel loyalty alliance is redirecting growth to Saudi Arabia, so watch for new Gulf loyalty tie-ups.
